items.title: Could Microsoft spin off Xbox? Why it might be worth billions
items.summary: Peter Levin of Griffin Gaming Partners explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi why Xbox could be strategically expendable within Microsoft while its franchises, platform, and intellectual property may represent a multibillion-dollar standalone asset. He then breaks down why Grand Theft Auto takes a decade to develop—and why GTA VI could generate extraordinary demand.
